title: Semester Examination Timetable and Schedule
content: The End-Semester Examination Timetable for Odd Semester (Winter) and Even Semester (Summer) is published by the Controller of Examinations. Theory examinations are held in two sessions: Morning Session (10:00 AM to 1:00 PM) and Afternoon Session (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM). Students must carry hall tickets and college identity cards.
